purpose: Research seed for executor review. Candidates require target-host qualification before auto-selection.
package_sizes: Payload bytes only. Runtime assets, build caches, and acquisition headroom are separate.

official-cuda.installation: pin complete Python/CUDA environment during qualification

remominor.installation: qualify isolated hybrid loader and lock dependencies first

gust.installation: Apple Silicon with at least 16 GB per server guard

stock-mlx-audio.installation: qualify and lock a codec-boundary-fixed release (at least 0.5.9)

speech-swift.installation: verify release build and model compatibility on target Apple Silicon

activation: Verify content digests and model terms, lock executable dependencies, prove actual device/precision and required voice modes, then record per-host measured qualification before auto-selection.
selection_notes: Order is for qualification. Choose the best measured narration quality within the actual device, RAM, disk and turnaround budget.
Consider fully GPU Vulkan Q8 on a tight device only if live load and generation peaks have room.
Choose one qualified runtime package and its required model packages. Do not fetch all alternatives.
The GPU check must detect unexpected CPU fallback. Explicit CPU text encoding is a distinct profile.
Pin job identity across resume. Adding new assets does not replace active or paused job assets.
